# Project Governance 2.8.2

Repositories can declare trusted private npm registries by exact package scope using the optional
`npm_registries` mapping in `config/policies/dependency-freshness.yaml`. Lockfile tarballs, release
freshness evidence, operator overrides, and scoped `.npmrc` declarations use the same registry
binding. Each binding includes the exact HTTPS origin and registry path prefix.

Unconfigured scopes and unscoped packages continue to use public npm. Exact package/version checks,
SHA-512 lock integrity, release-age rules, and override expiry remain enforced. Wildcards, credentials,
ambiguous URLs, and global registry redirects remain rejected. Private Yarn configuration is not
added by this patch.

Upgrade the runtime before adding the optional policy field. Projects can keep their valid private
package URLs; declare the matching scope and registry instead of rewriting URLs to pass validation.
See the [registry trust contract](https://github.com/copper-labs/project-governance/blob/2.8.2/docs/specs/governance-kernel.md#explicit-npm-registry-trust)
for the configuration example. Projects upgrading from before 2.8.1 must also follow the documented
dependency-locking launcher refresh and reinstall sequence.
